name: quenching
description: Marketplace hosting quenching: a 7-front aligner for the docs/ OKF bundle, /.design/ source, .claude/ automation, operations, verification, toolchain, and delivery surfaces, alongside the provider-owned specs and read-only security and git pillars.

plugins.name: quenching
plugins.description: Forces any repository's 7 local fronts into one canonical shape and keeps them conformant: the docs/ OKF bundle, /.design/ source, .claude/ automation, declared operations, verification, toolchain, and delivery surfaces. Provider-owned specs plus read-only security and git remain explicit axes without a local align. One root align conducts all 7 local fronts in dependency order on one confirmation and loops until nothing changes. The 7 fronts are probe-first; a clean front stops. Every command is one file whose path is its identity, backed by deterministic stdlib Python rails with uniform --json output and strict exit codes.

plugins.name: quenching-codex
plugins.description: Generated Codex sibling of the quenching Claude plugin. The generated manifest, skills, and copied assets are kept in deterministic lockstep with the Claude source.

plugins.name: quenching-specs-reader
plugins.description: Read-only view of another project's provider-owned quenching specs: one command, /quenching-specs-reader:read, that a target (an Obsidian vault reading its to-do list, for example) enables alone, without the full quenching plugin. Its cq-specs-read entry admits only read verbs and disables every backend write. Its payload and version are generated from plugins/quenching.
